publishing.name: Cubism SDK / Publication License
publishing.finding: The SDK is downloadable at no initial cost. Business entities must sign the SDK Release License (Publication License Agreement) at least one month before release; individuals and Small-Scale Enterprises are exempt except for "Expandable Applications". VTubing needs a separate agreement above 20 million yen annual revenue "under certain conditions"; VTuber tracking software counts as an Expandable Application.

publishing.name: VTube Studio model requirements
publishing.finding: Needs <model>.model3.json, <model>.moc3 and the texture folder in a Live2DModels folder. Export from Cubism with File > Export For Runtime > Export as .moc3 (export version SDK 3.0, 3.3, 4.0, 5.0 or newer) and export physics3.json. Large textures may lag or crash on mobile. Only Cubism .moc3 is confirmed; Inochi formats are UNVERIFIED.

publishing.name: Official sample models
publishing.finding: Governed by the Free Material License Agreement and the Cubism Sample Data Terms of Use; commercial rights UNVERIFIED (terms not read). Sample code CubismWebSamples/NativeSamples 5-r.5 (2026-04-02).
